Commentary.Commentary: A forgettable outing for the Australian bowlers although they did seem fairly in control during the first 23 overs when the score read just 93/2. However, once the onslaught started from Kaur, nobody had an answer as she absolutely waded into the bowlers with total disdain. This is going to be a tough chase but Australia do have the firepower in their ranks. Advantage India for now but don't count the defending champions out just yet. Join us in a while for the chase.

What a batting performance from India, or should I say, Harmanpreet Kaur! The Indian vice-captain stepped up in this big semi final to play one of the greatest knocks in the history of Women's cricket to propel India into an imposing total. The openers failed but Kaur was determined, initially repairing the innings with her skipper Raj before notching up a blistering stand with Deepti Sharma that was dominated by the Punjabi lass. Their stand ensured that the Batting Powerplay was totally utilized and Veda then struck a few lusty blows to take the total past the 280-run mark.
Full and around off, Veda bludgeons it to the wide long on region as the batters steal the second run as well. INDIA FINISH ON 281/4.
50-run stand comes up.
FOUR! Finds the fence! Fuller and wide outside off, Veda drives it uppishly. Finds the gap well and that's another boundary to the total. Damage is now from both ends.
Kaur is really struggling now! Tries to go for the big shot down the ground but mistimes it towards long on. Goes to the fielder on a few bounces as the batsmen take a single.
Another full ball around middle, squeezed out off the inner half to square leg. Just a single. India won't mind this as Kaur is back on strike!
Very full and outside off, blasted away down the ground but straight to the long off fielder. Just a single.
FOUR! That's been flayed! Short and wide oustide off, cut ferociously with no intent to keep it down. Wide of the backward point fielder and it races away to the fence for a boundary.
Megan Schutt to bowl the last over...
Mistimed but doesn't carry! Full and outside off, Kaur for a change doesn't connect the lofted stroke that well. One bounce to long off as they take a single.
Leg bye! Drifting in around leg stump, Veda looks to sweep but is hit on the pads as the ball goes to the leg side. They take a leg bye.
FOUR! Veda's turn to join in the fun. Floated around leg stump, steps out to that one and clobbers it over mid-wicket. In the gap and it races away to the fence for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, driven down to long off for a single.

SIX! BOOM! 2 IN 2! Flatter and on off stump, gets across to that one and slog sweeps it over deep mid-wicket this time. Top stroke and clears the ropes yet again. Running out of adjectives at the moment to describe her batting.

SIX! THAT'S INTO THE STANDS! Raining biggies from Kaur! Full toss and she slog sweeps it comfortably over deep square leg for a maximum. Clean strike and gets the best result. Not sure if bowling a spinner to her is the right idea. This could cost Australia big in this over.
Jess Jonassen is back on.

Fullish around middle, Kaur looks to slog across the line but gets it off the inner half to square leg. Another single, good over for Australia after a while. The batting powerplay yields 57 for India in the four overs for the loss of just a wicket.
Fullish ball outside off, driven crisply towards extra cover but cannot find the gap. Single taken.
Length ball wider outside off, makes room for the big shot but fails to get bat on ball.
Veda makes room as Perry angles it into the right-hander, worked on the leg side as the batsmen run quickly to steal a brace.
Fullish ball on the pads, leans across and flicks it towards the left of deep square leg for a single. Gets to 150 now, a knock of epic standards this has been.
Length ball around middle, steps out and heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Didn't quite middle it.
Ellyse Perry is back on.

FOUR! Finds the gap! High full toss and Kaur fetches it from outside off stump with a fine slap on the leg side. Splits deep backward square leg and deep mid-wicket with ease as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Full toss outside off, driven towards cover for a quick single.
Veda Krishnamurthy is in next. She scored a 45-ball 70 in the last game and showed her hitting prowess. Can she do it again?

OUT! VILLANI STRIKES! Some respite for Australia although this isn't the wicket they wanted. Slower ball and Deepti is way too early into the shot as she looks to slog. Misses it and finds the furniture behind her disturbed. She struggled to get going throughout but did well to rotate strike in this valuable 137-run stand that came off just 82 balls.
Fullish on the pads, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
Wide! That's one way of keeping her quiet but it comes at a price, an extra ball. Sprayed well outside off, left alone and it's a wide.

FOUR! Runs keep coming! Bowl it anywhere on any length, won't matter at the moment as Kaur is going berserk. Shorter and outside off, she stands tall and blasts it through the covers to find the fence. Cracking shot!
SIX! KABOOM! Business as usual at Kaur's end. She gets across to this fuller ball and slog sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. She is seeing the ball like a football at the moment.
Two Wides! False start by Villani! Sprayed down the leg side and Deepti cannot connect. Healy fumbles as the batsmen take the bonus run as well.
Elyse Villani to bowl her first over.
Superb yorker on off stump, dug out well to the bowler. 9 from the over, 32 in the two overs of Batting Powerplay.

FOUR! Up and over! It's all too easy for her right now. She is in that zone, is Kaur. Fullish ball outside off, reaches out and lifts it calmly down the ground. Clears mid off easily and it almost went all the way for a biggie.

FOUR! Connects this time and also finds the gap! Fullish ball outside off, Kaur gets on the front foot and unfurls a scorching drive between mid off and extra cover. She is toying with the bowling at the moment.
Full and wide outside off, makes room for the booming shot on the off side but misses.
NOT OUT! Sharma survives! Low full toss outside off, heaved towards mid on as they cross for the run. Direct hit at the bowler's end and it's referred upstairs. It was close but Deepti was just in.
Premeditates the paddle sweep as it is fired down the leg side. She misses as it just goes past leg stump.

Drifting in from around off stump, Kaur steps out and slices it over point. Just over the infield and they get a brace. Excellent over for India, 23 runs from it, they have begun the batting Powerplay with a bang.
Stat - Harmanpreet Kaur has now the highest individual score for India in Women's World Cup, beating Mithali Raj's 109 against New Zealand, 2017. What a match to achieve it!
FOUR! And another! Carnage at the moment! Steps out again and takes it on the full as she bashes this in the gap between extra cover and mid off. Splits the gap well to find the fence.

FOUR! BANG! Kaur, you beauty! Vintage hitting and the Aussie bowlers are being dismantled at the moment. Steps out to this flighted delivery and lofts it cleanly inside out over extra cover. No protection and it goes to the wide long off fence for a boundary.
100-run stand between Sharma and Kaur.

SIX! AND AGAIN! What batting this is! This time waits in the crease and slog sweeps it powerfully over deep square leg for another biggie. Meaty blow and clears the ropes with ease. Brings up the 200 for India.

SIX! That's clobbered! Kaur continues to put her dancing shoes on. Makes terrific connection and lifts it over mid-wicket. Struck it well as it goes to the fence. The umpires want to check if it is a boundary or a biggie. After numerous replays, the third umpire decides that it is a maximum as the ball landed on the ropes.
Floated outside off, steps out and mistimes the heave to the right of deep square leg. Single taken.
Batting Powerplay has been taken now. It's of 4 overs today. Ashleigh Gardner comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Slammed! Full toss and it's been dispatched to the fence. Kaur gets forward to that one and blasts the drive through the covers as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.

Dicey moment! Fullish and outside off, Kaur misses the drive and Healy fumbles as the batsman comes out of the crease. Fortunately for Kaur, the ball had gone behind a bit and that allowed her to get back.
Low full toss outside off, dug out back to the bowler down the track.
Fullish and angling into the left-hander, heaved away to deep backward square leg for a single.

Some issue with the stump mic and hence there is a small delay. Players are enjoying an unofficial drinks break. Australia will take this opportunity to gather and rethink their strategies. India, on the other hand, will hope that this break won't hamper their momentum.
On a length outside off, Deepti tries to squeeze it out but is beaten.
Back of a length on off stump, swung away to the right of deep square leg for a couple.
Megan Schutt is back on.
3rd ODI hundred for Harmanpreet Kaur!

NOT OUT! That's it, a century for Kaur and boy, isn't she happy! This has been an exceptional knock so far, pure class! Coming to the ball, she worked it gently on the leg side and there was two on offer. However, there is a mix up on the second run before they eventually go through. Direct hit at the bowler's end by Healy as Deepti put in a dive. Seemed okay to the naked eye but the umpires want to be sure. Replays confirm that she is safe and immediately, Kaur is pumped up as she celebrates her ton. Take a bow, girl!
Run out appeal is referred upstairs....
Drifting in from outside off, Deepti uses her feet and mistimes the slog to long on for a single.
Floated outside off, steps out and swings it on the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Another boundary! She is inching closer to her century. Floated outside off, Kaur gets across and slog sweeps it powerfully to the wide long on fence for a boundary. Split long on and deep mid-wicket to perfection.
Floated around leg stump, gets across and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg. Single taken.
Floated around middle, Kaur uses his feet to play the big shot but toe-ends it to long on for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, leans across and flicks it on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! More runs! Dynamic stuff from Kaur. Fuller around leg stump, she steps out and adjusts to drag it to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Strong bottom hand and wrist work from her.
SIX! What a hit! This is excellent batting. Kaur steps out to this flighted delivery and launches it effortlessly over long on for a biggie. High quality batting!
Had to hurry! Deepti uses her feet and works it to the leg side for a quick single.
Fuller around off, Kaur drives it to long on for a single.
Floated outside off, Kaur goes across to sweep but gets a bottom edge towards third man for a single.
On middle and leg, worked on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time! Drifting in from outside off, Kaur leans forward and drives it sweetly wide of the cover-point fielder as the ball races to the fence. Nicely done by the vice-captain.
Tossed up outside off, Kaur bludgeons the drive but straight to extra cover.
Fuller outside off, Deepti steps out and chips it down the ground. Well short of the long on fielder as they take a single.
Drags it short outside off, Kaur advances down the pitch and slaps it to deep square leg for a run.
Flatter and outside off, gets back and drags the pull to deep backward square leg for a single.
Flatter around off, goes across and sweeps it to short fine leg.

FOUR! Yes it is! Lucky runs though for Kaur! She tries to go big on the leg side but skews it high over the keeper towards the third man fence. Gardner gives chase and puts in a tumbling effort as she pulls the back into play. The umpires want to check the stop and replays show that her foot had touched the rope while she made contact with the ball. Another boundary! 50-run stand up.
Is it a four? Ashleigh Gardner appears to have made the stop but was her leg in contact with the rope? The third umpire is referred.
Fuller outside off, driven towards the covers.

FOUR! Mauled! This is batting of the highest order by Kaur. Steps out and finds length shortened but she adjusts really well. Clobbers it uppishly and places it wide of the long on fielder for a boundary. She is single-handedly infusing life into the innings for India.
Flatter around off stump, Deepti goes down on one knee and sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Flatter ball on middle, Kaur hangs back and powers it down to long on for a single.
Jess Jonassen is back on.
Good length around off, tap and run as they sneak a single as the ball goes to cover-point. Smart batting!

FOUR! Super shot! Kaur motors along. Shorter in length and she swivels to help the pull over backward square leg. Clean strike and it races to the fence for a boundary. Just used the pace of the bowler and placed it in the gap. Terrific batting!

Shortish around middle, Deepti swivels to pull it towards deep backward square leg as the fielder tidies up. Just a single taken, India haven't been good in converting ones into twos. They have to work on it.
Very full and on off stump, dug out to the vacant space at mid-wicket as they sneak a single.
Wide! Angling into the batsman, slides down the leg side as Kaur misses the flick. Wide called.
Fullish ball on the pads, worked in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Wide! Length ball angling across the left-hander, too wide and Deepti lets it pass.
Length ball outside off, stays back and defends it to the off side.
Full toss outside off, drilled to long off for a single.
Fuller outside off, leans across and drives it to the bowler.
FOUR! Gutsy from Deepti! There is a slip in place but she goes for the late cut. Plays it really well and beats the fielder to get it towards the third man fence. Nicely batted!
Flatter and outside off, stays back and slaps it towards point.
Drifting in from outside off, steps out to that one and taps it towards cover.
Floated around middle, leans across and wrists it down to long on for a single.
Drinks break....
Fullish ball around middle, nicely clipped by Deepti through mid-wicket. Neat placement and she picks a brace.
Fuller ball outside off, bunted past her partner as it goes down to long on. Single taken.

Run out missed! Length ball on middle, gets back and taps it to the off side as they steal a quick single. Blackwell's throw at the bowler's end misses and that saved Deepti who was well short despite a dive.
Full and outside off, nudged gently towards long on as the batsmen take a single.
Full toss on the pads, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full and around off stump, Sharma gets forward and taps it towards cover. Kaur wanted the single but is sent back.
Ellyse Perry is back on for another spell.
A low full toss on off, Sharma top edges her sweep towards fine leg. It lands safely and they cross for a single.
Prods forward to a full ball and defends.
Charges down the track and slaps it past wide mid on for a single.

Excellent piece of fielding by Villani! Tossed up ball on off, it's driven through extra cover and Villani sprints across to her right from long off. She puts in a slide to pull it back and goes herself beyond the line. The ball now once again starts to roll back but Villani shows great presence of mind there. Keeps herself away when she was in contact with the rope and only after she has returned, she touched the ball. Sends it back in play towards the bowler's end. Saves two for her side.
Leans forward and taps it down to point for a single.
Gets on the back foot and punches it straight to the cover fielder.
10th ODI fifty for Kaur.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Long hop on off, Kaur gets deep inside the crease and hammer-pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary. What a knock this has been from Harmanpreet!
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and blocks.

SIX! Ho! Ho! Ho! The superstar of the Indian women's team shines and packs a punch. Shimmies down the track to a full ball and launches it over long on for a maximum. That was a massive bat swing by Kaur.
Free Hit coming up.

Whoa! What happened there? The bowler completely loses control over the ball and serves a very high full toss which goes nearly towards short third man. The keeper runs back to collect the ball and the umpire calls it a no ball for being above waist high.
Jumps out of the crease and whips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it straight to covers.
Advances down the track and nudges it to long off for a single.
Gets forward and defends it down safely.
Strides out to a full ball and defends it back to the bowler.
Quicker on off, defended from the front foot.
Floated one on off, pushed off the front foot to extra cover.
Gets back and plays it through point for a single.
Leans on the front foot and pushes it to covers.
Deepti Sharma is the new batter in.

OUT! Sound of timber! Beams jumps in delight, it's a massive breakthrough as the Indian skipper departs. A leg spinner is sent across quicker in pace around off, it doesn't turn much as Mithali goes back to play at it late. Fails in doing so and finds her stumps rattled. Australia have managed to break the 66-run stand.

Dropped by Blackwell! Half-tracker by Beams, Raj gets back and pulls it across the line. It's aerial, Blackwell at mid-wicket jumps to take the catch over head but it brushes her fingers and runs behind. A couple taken.
Goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it in the air. The fielder at deep square leg moves across to her right and collects the ball on one bounce. A single taken.
Floated full ball on middle, Mithali advances down the track and forces it to long off for one.
Gets down on one knee and sweeps it aerially over backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, helped straight to mid-wicket.
Kristen Beams is back on.
Runs down the track, a premeditated charge and then Raj squeezes out a full ball to covers.
Gets down on one knee for the sweep shot but fails to connect. It goes behind off the her pads and they steal a leg bye.
Gets forward to a full ball in defense.
Advances down the track to a fuller length ball outside off, drives it square of the of the wicket on the off side for a run.
Loopy full ball on off, worked on the leg side after coming down the track and beat mid-wicket for a single.
Full flighted ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Ashleigh Gardner is back on.
Tries to tickle it on the leg side but it takes the inside half of the bat and runs fine down the leg side for one.

Stumping chance goes down begging! Fuller and sliding down the leg side, Kaur walks down the track with her flick shot but misses. Healy fumbles otherwise it would have been a stumping chance. Called a wide!
A touch short and wide outside off, Kaur looks to play at it late by shuffling across the stumps but misses.
Mithali Raj is now the leading run scorer in the tournament.
Fullish and outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Nicely played with a straight bat. Full and on off, eased down to long on for a single. A conscious effort by Kaur to keep the scoreboard ticking.
FOUR! Cheeky from Harmanpreet! Fuller length ball angling into the batsman, Kaur premeditates her paddle scoop and unfurls it perfectly to fetch a boundary at fine leg.
Brings a straight bat down to a full ball around off and pushes it towards mid on. The short mid-wicket fielder makes the stop.
Megan Schutt is back into the attack. Australia would like to break this dangerous looking partnership.
Quicker delivery on middle, an arm ball, Raj closes the face of the bat and helps it to mid-wicket.
50-run stand between Raj and Kaur.
Loopy full ball on off, it's pushed with an open face through point for a single. Handy partnership, this.
Gets deep inside the crease and forces it to long on for a single.
Smart batting. Scores a boundary and now just taps a full ball towards cover-point and rotates the strike with a single.

FOUR! Catch it is the shout but it has gone over mid off. Great footwork by Harmanpreet Kaur, dances down the track to a full ball, takes the calculative risk as the fielder is inside the ring and lofts it over her for a boundary. Beauty!
A touch short and around off, skidding in, Raj gets back and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Steps down the track and pushes a full ball to long on for a single. Good over for India.
Flatter and on the pads, Kaur gets back and helps it behind square leg for a single.
Walks forward and across to play it on the leg side. Finds mid-wicket inside the ring.

FOUR! Boom! Look at that backlift by Harmanpreet. A loopy ball around off, fuller in length, Kaur kneels and nails her slog sweep over mid-wicket. Fine connection and it speeds away to the fence. No chance for the fielder in the deep.
Flighted again, full and outside off, driven straight to covers.

Flighted leg spinner landing on leg, not turning, Raj fails to flick and it goes off her pads past the keeper. The short fine leg fielder moves across to her right to stop the ball, they cross for a leg bye.
Arm ball this time, around off and skidding in, Mithali goes back and punches it to long for a single. Five singles from the over!
Nicely tossed up, around off, Kaur uses her feet and sends it to long on for one more run in the over.
Flatter and fuller on off, Raj with a short footwork drives it to long off for another run.
Full and flighted on off, Harmanpreet is down the track and she eases it to long on for a single.
Floated one, full and on off, Kaur gets forward and defends it back.
Walks down the track to a fuller length ball and drives it past the diving cover fielder for a single.
Jess Jonassen to have another go.
A touch short and skidding in around middle, Kaur gets back and defends it towards Beams. Tidy over!
Lunges to a full ball and defends it watchfully near her front pad.
Fuller in length outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Googly landing around off, spinning back in, Kaur reads it late, gets back inside the crease and at the last moment keeps it out.
Flatter this time, around leg, Mithali gets back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted full ball on off, spinning away a shade, Kaur jumps out of the crease and forces it down to long on for a run.
Good length ball on off, Harmanpreet gets back and taps it down in the gap at covers for a quick single.
Fuller she goes this time with her length, outside off, Kaur drives it towards extra cover.
Short around off, pulled on the leg side but straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Some extra bounce on this occasion, on middle and leg, Raj tries working it on the leg side but ends up playing it a bit aerially. Lands safely in front of square leg and they cross.

A touch short again, outside off, Harmanpreet cracks her pull shot, a shade uppish and Villani at mid-wicket does well to dive and slow down the pace. Parries it towards wide mid on and they cross for a run.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Mithali swivels on the back foot and works it behind square leg for a single.
Slow loopy ball on middle, Kaur plays an on drive and the short mid-wicket fielder intervenes with a dive to stop the ball.
Landing around leg and turning down, maybe, Kaur fails to flick and it clips her pads. Goes wide of the keeper but towards short fine leg.
Uses her feet to reach the pitch of the delivery and drives it to long off for a single.
Long hop outside off, Harmanpreet gets inside the crease and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Once again a bad ball goes unpunished.
Flighted full ball on off, defended back off the front foot.

Huge shout for an lbw! Tossed up ball landing around leg, Kaur leans forward in defense, probably playing for the spin which is not there and gets beaten. She is rapped on the pads, the bowler and the keeper appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Not spinning much and might have missed the leg stump.
Length delivery drifting down the leg side, Kaur tucks it behind square leg and takes a single.
Very full in length and wide outside off, it's squeezed out to the off side but straight to the point fielder.
Full toss outside off, pushed straight to mid off. Once again a poor delivery has not been punished.
Lands it full and just outside off, Harmanpreet gets forward and drives it past the bowler. However, the mid off fielder had it covered.
Mid-wicket comes inside the circle. In fact, there are two mid-wicket in place. Expect a stump-to-stump line.
A full toss on this occasion, around leg, Mithali works it in front of square leg and takes a single. Fails to make maximum use of that gift on her pads.
Initiates proceedings after drinks with a fuller length ball on off, Mithali gets on the front foot and pushes it back to the bowler.
Ellyse Perry is back for another spell.
Drinks break....
Jumps out of the crease to a full ball and drives it to long off for a run.
Skidding down again, Mithali fails to flick and it goes off her pads to the leg side. Healy collects it quickly.
This one skids back into the batter from a fuller length around off, Kaur lunges to defend but it takes the inner half of the bat and rolls behind square leg for a run.
Flighted and full on off, Kaur gets forward and defends it back.
Once again it's a low full toss on middle, Raj uses her feet and eases it straight back past the bowler to long on for a single.
A flighted ball around leg, Raj advances down the track, takes it on the full and hits it straight back.
Kristen Beams is introduced into the attack.
Flighted on off stump, gets across and drives it to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, reaches out and defends it towards point.
Flighted outside off, steps out and eases it towards extra cover for a single.
Floated around middle, leans across and drives it to long on for a single.
Quicker ball outside off, stays back and defensd it to the off side.
Flatter around middle, stays back and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Brings up the 50 for India.
Fuller ball outside off, gets forward and defends it to the off side.

FOUR! TOP SHOT! Kaur is showing her class. Fuller ball around off stump, she meets it with the full face of the bat and strokes it straight back past the bowler. Placed it very, very straight and it rockets to the fence for a boundary. Two fielders were chasing it but couldn't get to it in time.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends it to the bowler.
Darted in around off stump, tapped to the left of the bowler who gets across to stop it.
A bit short around middle, defended from the crease to the bowler.

FOUR! CLASSY FROM KAUR! Half volley outside off, she reaches out to it nicely and unfurls a delicious drive through the covers. Nice extension of the hands and a beautiful stride forward to pick up a boundary.
Floated around off, leans across and drives it down to long on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Kaur leans into it and defends with a straight bat.
Full and outside off, driven down the ground to long off for a single.
Beaten! Nice drift for Gardner and induces the drive from Mithali. She is beaten by the bounce as Healy fumbles.
Drifting in from outside off, stays back and taps it towards point.
Fuller outside off, walks down the track and eases it towards mid off.
Continues to persist on a length in that fifth stump channel, tapped to the off side.
Length ball wider outside off, dabbed gently to the off side for a single.
Back of a length outside off, gets back and glides it to third man for a single.
Fullish ball on off stump, gets on the front foot and defends it to the bowler.
Another wide length ball, Raj opens the bat face to run it down to third man for a single.
On a length well outside off, Mithali lets it pass to teh keeper.
Megan Schutt is back on. The keeper is standing up to the stumps. A short third man in place along with a short mid-wicket.
Drifting in from outside off, Raj uses her feet and drives it to long off for a single.
Fuller outside off, gets across and blocks it to the off side.
Flighted on off stump, gets on the front foot and blocks solidly.
Slightly short and outside off, stays back and defends it towards cover.
Harmanpreet Kaur arrives at number 4.

OUT! GONE THIS TIME! Gardner strikes but this is a poor shot from Raut. There is a deep mid-wicket in place but she still goes for the slog across the line. Doesn't quite get it off the meat and finds Mooney stationed near the fence who takes a low catch.
Almost a wicket first ball! Floated around middle, steps out to drive but chips it down the track. Almost carried to Gardner.
More spin on the menu as Ashleigh Gardner comes on to bowl.
Quicker ball on off stump, gets back and pats it back to the bowler.
Mid on drops back.
Mitchell Starc is present to support his team!

FOUR! THERE SHE GOES AGAIN! Mithali seems to have come out with intent. Flighted around middle, dances down the track and lifts it straight over the bowler's head. Nimble footwork and good connection fetches her a boundary.
Tossed up on off stump, Raj gets well forward to that one and defends it well.
The slider around middle, Raut hangs back and clips it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Flatter ball outside off, stays back and defends it towards point.
Flighted outside off, Raut leans forward and blocks it to short cover.
Fullish outside off, nice drive by Raj but finds the fielder at cover.

FOUR! BANG! Aggression from Mithali! Fullish ball around middle, she stands tall and nonchalantly dispatches it down the ground. There is a fielder at mid on but this was lofted much straighter as it rockets to the fence.
Full and wide outside off, driven towards point for a single.
Low full toss outside off, driven towards extra cover where there is a fumble. Parried to mid off where Lanning also fumbles before firing the throw back. Sharp single taken.
Just short! Already signs that the track doesn't have enough carry. Length ball wider outside off, Raut flashes at it but gets a thin edge. Doesn't carry to Healy.

Another good run taken! Full and around off stump, nips in a bit as Raut gets a faint inside edge onto the pads as the ball rolls beside the sticks. Mithali is aware and eggs her partner through for the single.
Flatter and around middle, blocked off the inner half to the leg side.
Loopy around middle, Mithali uses her feet this time and taps it down the pitch.
Loopy outside off, a bit of extra bounce as Mithali is beaten on the cut.
Drifting in from around off, pushed off the back foot towards silly point.
Wide! Flatter and well outside off, left alone as it shoots through low. Wide called.
Drifting in on a length on middle, nudged off the back foot to mid-wicket for a brisk run. Good to see the Indian top order stressing on the quick singles.
Shorter and a bit flatter on off stump, tapped gently back to the bowler.

Jess Jonassen is the first bowling change. She has done superbly in the tournament so far. Generally has opened the bowling, today a different role. A silly point in place, Alex Blackwell. Meg Lanning on the attack.
Fuller ball around middle, leans across and drives it towards mid on.
Another yorker targeting the stumps and Mithali jams it out in time.
Length ball outside off, leans into it and punches it towards mid off.
Length ball around middle, leans across and clips it towards the leg side.
Very full and outside off, dug out towards the covers.
Fires a yorker on off stump, Mithali does well dig it out to the leg side.

FOUR! CHEEKY FROM RAUT! No slips in place and she plays this length ball very late. Opens the face to run it down wide of the keeper. Nobody at third man and it races to the fence for a boundary. Productive over for the Indians.
Short of a good length outside off, Punam leaves it alone to the keeper.
Wide! Length ball wider outside off, left alone to the keeper. Too wide and it's signaled by the umpire.

FOUR! Strays in line and put away! Shortens the length but it is in leg stump and Raut pounces on it. Swivels to help it on its way down to the fine leg fence. The fielder puts in a desperate dive but cannot prevent the boundary.
On a good length wider outside off, Raut reaches out and pats it to point.
Pitched fuller outside off, Punam lets it pass to the keeper.
Full and outside off, gets on the front foot and taps it towards point.

Had to hurry! Full and outside off, Raut taps it to mid off and they hare through for a single. She puts in a dive as the shy misses at the bowler's end. Had it hit, things could have been close but Lanning isn't fully fit and so can only throw under arm.
Length ball around middle, nudged to the leg side for a sharp single. Positive intent and it's good to see.

Overpitched delivery outside off, Raj leans into it and caresses the drive behind point. Timed beautifully but the slow outfield denies her a boundary. Third man fielder comes around to tidy up as the batsmen take a couple.
Sharp stuff! Perry surprises Mithali with a pacy bumper around the middle stump line. The Indian captain does well to evade it.
Full toss but Mithali doesn't cash in. Toe-ends the drive towards mid on.
Fullish around middle, Raj gets across and checks her drive towards mid on.
And again! Almost a replica of the last ball as there is sharp inward movement from a wider spot outside off, left alone by Raut.
Sharp movement! Schutt gets this to jag back a long way from outside off, the line is wide and so Raut makes a comfortable leave despite the movement.
Length ball around middle, Raut gets across and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Raut gets on the front foot and taps it to the off side.
Fuller ball outside off, reaches out and defends solidly to cover.
Wide! Very full and wide off stump, left alone and that's a wide.
Just short of a full length outside off, Raut gets forward and defends it on to the track.
Solidly blocked by Raj after getting on the front foot to the full ball.
Fullish ball outside off, Raj gets forward and defends well.

Gets a bit of shape into Raut who looks to push at it tentatively. Gets a faint inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls to the leg side. Single taken. There was an appeal for lbw but clear inside edge.
Fullish again outside off, Raut reaches out and defends it to the off side.
Another full ball outside off, Raut jabs it towards the off side.
Full and outside off, Raut gets forward and taps it towards cover.
ELLYSE PERRY to bowl from the other end.
MITHALI RAJ is in next.

OUT! GOT HER! Mandhana fails yet again and this is just the start Australia would have wanted. A half-hearted stroke really, tries to go back on the off side and punch through the line but skews it high towards point where Villani backtracks to take an easy catch. Smriti's rough form continues...
Full and outside off, leans forawrd and blocks it solidly.
Sloppy fielding! Back of a length outside off, tapped gently towards backward point where there is a fumble and it allows the pair to take a brace.
Takes the pace off a bit and targets the stumps, played back to the bowler.

FOUR! FAB SHOT! That should give her some confidence. Shortish outside off, stands tall and punches it on the up through the covers. Slightly aerial but also in the gap as it races to the fence for a boundary.
Back of a length wider outside off, Mandhana gets back and taps it gently towards point.

The National Anthems are done and out come the players with the umpires. SMRITI MANDHANA and PUNAM RAUT to open the batting for India. MEGAN SCHUTT to start for Australia. Just a square gully in place, no slips.

MEG LANNING says that it is a good toss to lose as she wasn't sure of what to do. Opines that it is crucial to start well in this big game. Feels that not having lost too many overs due to rain is a good thing. Says that the side is relaxed and they have rested well thanks to the delay. Reveals the one obvious change, SHE COMES IN FOR RACHAEL HAYNES.

MITHALI RAJ says that India will bat first. Feels that the track looks good despite the rain. Feels that having played four games at the venue is handy for his side in a must-win game. States that her girls are motivated enough and that the delay hasn't affected her girls. Ends by saying that INDIA ARE UNCHANGED.
INDIA WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT.

India have the advantage of having played four games here and are yet to lose a game in the tournament at this venue. That will boost their confidence in this big game. Australia won't be too worried, considering their adaptability and flexibility as an outfit. The rain delay has meant that we will have a 42-OVERS-A-SIDE CONTEST NOW. Toss is coming up shortly.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the second semi final of the 2017 Women's World Cup in Derby. The defending champions prevailed in a one-sided encounter when the two sides clashed earlier in the tournament. That counts for little though in a knockout scenario and it's about which side handles the pressure better.
